description: This Kotlin source file defines the CameraHandler class responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, and recording clips in an Android application. It includes functions for handling camera actions, error reporting, payload size validation, and logging during camera interactions.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling camera-related functionalities such as listing devices, taking snapshots, recording clips, error handling, and logging within an Android application context.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Handles the listing of available camera devices and returns the information as a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Captures a photo using the camera, manages related UI feedback, error handling, and returns the photo payload encoded in base64.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip, checks payload size, manages UI feedback, and returns the video data encoded in base64, handling errors and audio inclusion.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses the includeAudio parameter from JSON to determine if audio should be captured during video recording.
